author: (Ev. Marcus, 1971)

note.en: A dorid nudibranch recorded here from two specimens taken at 9 and 12 m off Cahuita and north of Manzanillo in 1998 and 1999. Uncommon where it occurs, and the size is not documented in sources read.
note.es: Un nudibranquio doridáceo registrado aquí por dos ejemplares tomados a 9 y 12 m frente a Cahuita y al norte de Manzanillo en 1998 y 1999. Poco común donde vive, y su talla no se documenta en las fuentes leídas.

evidence: GBIF: 2 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 1998 and 1999)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón

marks.en: Flat, oval, warty-looking sea slug with brown to orange body speckled with white.
marks.es: Babosa de mar plana, ovalada y de aspecto verrugoso, pardo a naranja salpicada de blanco.
